pages.text: Once placed, the Mound corrupts the terrain around it, making it dangerous. It will start to create various hazardous blocks, which will drop Biomass if mined, which is an important material to obtain various things such as Andesite. Be careful as making contact with some of these blocks will hurt you!

Every 15 minutes, the Mound will grow by one stage, and its infestation radius will increase. It can start to cause serious problems once it reaches stage 4, its final stage. A stage 4 Mound will infest blocks in a radius of 20 blocks around it. The Mound also grows in size every time its stage increases.

Once reaching stage 3, a Mound will periodically scan nearby chests for food in a large radius, and will eventually make a level 1 Mound grow on it. This process can be made quicker by placing multiple chests or using Time in a Bottle. Mounds can feed off any kind of food: if you can eat it, a Mound can too. Not a picky eater, i'm sure you could even invite one next time you go to the restaurant to eat with friends.

Once reaching stage 4, the Mound will summon hostile creatures that will pose a threat if not contained. It will occasionally summon a Scamper, which is a creature that can turn into more Mounds, or occasionally evolve into a Gastgeber, which is... something scarier.$(br2)Once created, a Mound can be quite difficult to move around. However, some Create components might be able to push or move it around.
